notes: Strymon Iridium is a guitar-pedal-format amp/cab modeler (analog JFET preamp + 24-bit/96kHz IR-based cab simulation), not a traditional rack/room AV device — no rackUnits (desktop/floorboard footprint, 4.5"D x 4"W x 1.75"-2.4"T depending on source). Category/type were mapped to the closest available options (audio/DSP); "Other" would also be defensible. Primary specs (I/O jack types, impedances, power) confirmed on Strymon's own hardware-specs FAQ and product page (strymon.net). USB connector is physically USB Mini-B per Strymon documentation/retailers — "usb-micro" used as the closest id in the allowed connector list, not an exact match. The EXP/MIDI jack is a single multi-function 1/4" TRS jack (expression pedal or MIDI-over-TRS accessory); marked as input since its primary function is accepting external control, though MIDI automation could be considered bidirectional in some setups. No ports on this device fall on a graded connector scale (no HDMI/SDI/DisplayPort/USB-speed/Ethernet), so no "grade" values were set.

ports.name: IN
ports.note: Single combo jack; accepts mono TS (instrument/line, default) or stereo TRS (requires TRS adapter cable). Input impedance 1M ohm, max input level +8dBu.

ports.name: OUT L
ports.note: Unbalanced 1/4" output. Used alone for mono output. Output impedance 100 ohm.

ports.name: OUT R
ports.note: Unbalanced 1/4" output, right channel of stereo pair.

ports.name: Headphones
ports.note: 1/8" stereo headphone output, discrete transistor headphone amp, level set by front-panel LEVEL knob.

ports.name: EXP/MIDI
ports.note: Multi-function 1/4" TRS jack for a standard expression pedal, or a Strymon MiniSwitch / MultiSwitch Plus / MIDI EXP cable for remote preset selection and MIDI automation.

ports.name: USB
ports.note: Physical connector is USB Mini-B (5-pin), not exactly in the provided connector list; closest available id used. Used for loading custom IRs via Strymon Impulse Manager and for firmware updates, not for audio.

ports.name: DC In
ports.note: 9VDC center-negative, 2.1 x 5.5mm barrel, 500mA minimum (300mA minimum if headphone output unused). Power supply not included.
